title: l2m.config.json
description: Inputs, folders and agent settings for the l2m CLI (@l2m/cli). Every field can be overridden by a command-line flag.

project.description: Product or project name used in prompts and new documents.

source.description: Legacy source tree(s). The first one is scanned by inventory.py; --src overrides.

docs.description: Existing documents, interview notes, specs and wiki links (files, folders or URLs); --docs adds more.

schema.description: DDL, DCLGEN and migration files or folders; --schema adds more.

targetStack.description: e.g. React 19 + Spring Boot 3 (Java 21) + DB2 for z/OS 13, or Unknown.

migrationStrategy.description: rewrite | convert | rehost per domain | Unknown.

agent.description: Default agent: claude, copilot, codex, gemini, or a name defined under agents.

agents.description: Override or add agent command templates. {prompt} becomes the prompt text, {prompt_file} a file holding it; with neither, the prompt goes to stdin.
